posts.text: Happy Easter weekend everyone. May God bless you and your families. 🙏🏾
I've travelled to nearly 50 countries and have concluded that governments are typically a poor representation of the general population. Even in supposed democracies.

Thoughts?


Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump)

The United States has spent EIGHT TRILLION DOLLARS fighting and policing in the Middle East. Thousands of our Great Soldiers have died or been badly wounded. Millions of people have died on the other side. GOING INTO THE MIDDLE EAST IS THE WORST DECISION EVER MADE.....



— https://nitter.net/realDonaldTrump/status/1181905659568283648#m

Social media posts that get an automatic 'like' from me 99% of the time, even if I don't know the people:

- Birth of a child
- Fitness transformations
- Positive health news
- Wholesome Christian content
- Marriages & engagements
- Beautiful art & photos

Also trains the algo

There are millions of people in this world who receive zero words of positivity, affirmation, or encouragement on any given day. I've kept that in mind for the last 20 years and always do my best to uplift people through what I say publicly. From tweets to podcasts to songs.


Bajan Bambino 🇺🇸🇧🇷 (@Bajan_Bambino)

Same here. Many have no clue how just a little positivity in a world of chaos can change someone’s day or trajectory



— https://nitter.net/Bajan_Bambino/status/2040047883773210849#m
My X audience. 💜
False accusations should carry a much greater social penalty than they currently do.

You could lower crime rates by 80-90% in most places by locking up repeat offenders and keeping them locked up. Or deporting them if they're not citizens. 

A very small % of the population does virtually all the serious crime. Perhaps 1-2% of all people.

See El Salvador, Japan, Gulf countries, Singapore...
It genuinely pains me to see great places slowly destroying themselves through terrible policies and bad leadership.

Good times... 2021.


🇦🇪 HGS (@Sajwani)

Do you know why Zuby was banned by Twitter ?

Because he wrote to someone “Ok Dude …”

🤣



— https://nitter.net/Sajwani/status/2039731962936803405#m

Every Western country and city needs to adopt tough on crime policies.

Zero tolerance for theft and violent crime.

This is so obvious, yet there is so much resistance.
Some good questions. 💜

Ask me anything for the next 20 minutes. I'll answer the good questions that I see.

Go.

Everybody trades freedom for safety to some degree. Absolute 'freedom' does not exist in any country and nobody would want it to in practice. If you think you are 'free', stop paying taxes and see what happens to you.


Mike Mkrodik (@mkrodik)

Sounds like you trade freedom for safety



— https://nitter.net/mkrodik/status/2039728789706412406#m
